tools.name: pacta_lookup_protocol
tools.description: Resolve a protocol or token name to Pacta's verified record: canonical slug and page URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (Base-EAS-attested vs RPC-observed only), and ready-to-use preflightArgs {chain, address} for pacta_check_preflight. 316 proto

tools.name: pacta_check_preflight
tools.description: One-call pre-execution safety check of a contract before an agent interacts with it: verdict (no controller found / timelock / zero-delay timelock / multisig / EOA admin / unclassified / undeployed) with the checks run, 0-100 risk score (null when not determined: no contract, or NO_CONTROLLER_FOUND)

tools.name: pacta_scan_wallet_exposure
tools.description: Read-only Multicall3 wallet & Gnosis Safe DeFi control-plane exposure scan across Ethereum and Base: Safe threshold/owners detection, ERC-20 / ERC-4626 / MetaMorpho balanceOf + symbol/decimals verification across 313 indexed protocols, portfolio 0-100 risk score, shortest exit window, position roste

tools.name: pacta_scan_control_plane
tools.description: Live control-plane scan of an EVM contract: EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon, owner(), Safe threshold/owners/guard, timelock delay, code size and deterministic risk flags at the latest (or a given) block. Free (no key, no payment).

tools.name: pacta_scan_timelock_op
tools.description: Live OpenZeppelin TimelockController operation state: isOperation/Pending/Ready/Done, getTimestamp (ETA), getMinDelay at the latest block. Free (no key, no payment).

tools.name: pacta_scan_proposal_diff
tools.description: Re-runs the pinned contract reads of a Pacta-tracked governance proposal (Aave, Euler, Morpho, Sky) at the live block and returns pinned-vs-live diffs. Free (no key, no payment).

tools.name: pacta_get_live_timelocks
tools.description: Live state of the public pending timelock operations tracked in https://pacta.wtf/api/v1/radar.json, each re-checked at the latest block (getTimestamp, isOperationPending, isOperationDone). Free (no key, no payment).

tools.name: pacta_submit_request
tools.description: Opt-in: queue a coverage or feature request with Pacta when a target is not indexed, a chain or check is unsupported, or data looks wrong (coverage_gap_hint). Ask the user first. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pacta_submit_request · Private data: pacta_lookup_protocol, pacta_scan_wallet_exposure · Public sink: pacta_submit_request · Destructive: pacta_check_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pacta_submit_request · Private data: pacta_lookup_protocol, pacta_scan_wallet_exposure · Public sink: pacta_submit_request · Destructive: pacta_check_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
